description: Update priv/pages/docs/getting-started/first-llm-agent.livemd to follow the Livebook Authoring Standards and remove any runtime or setup footguns that make the notebook harder than necessary for beginners.

comments.text: Rewrote priv/pages/docs/getting-started/first-llm-agent.livemd around the canonical Livebook beginner flow. Verified with mix test test/agent_jido/release_catalog_test.exs:62, INCLUDE_FLAKY_TESTS=true mix test test/agent_jido/pages_test.exs:183, and a mix run page-registry check for /docs/getting-started/first-llm-agent.
